**Primary Responsibilities**



* Effective planning, implementation and monitoring of the digital media campaigns in coordination with different stakeholders, with end\-to\-end ownership of the complete process
* Developing marketing strategies and campaign ideas by understanding brand language, audience preferences and competitive landscape
* Analysing data from ad campaigns and secondary sources to identify trends, insights and opportunities to optimize campaign performance
* Building and ensuring compliance to systems to ensure smooth execution of digital media campaigns
* Providing inputs and expertise to drive efficacy of marketing activities, starting from media planning to content development and finalizing ad targeting
* Creating and maintaining relationships with clients, advertising partners, influencers and publishers
* Managing the team by recruiting, orienting, and training team members



  





**Qualities we are looking for**



* Open\-minded, curious, and a strong problem\-solver
* Strong analytical skills and ability to leverage data to generate creative ideas and find opportunities for optimization
* Strong written, communication and presentation skills
* Ability to interact effectively with all levels of management and clients, and ensure smooth inter\-teams’ coordination

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in marketing or a related field from a leading Indian/International education institution
* Relevant experience of 3\+ years gained in either a full\-service agency or product/growth/brand management focused roles in a consumer\-facing organization

**We are looking for a creative and result\-oriented Social Media Marketing Executive who can manage and grow the company's digital presence across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, and YouTube.**

* Strong understanding of the Indian creator ecosystem across Instagram, YouTube, X, Facebook, and emerging regional platforms.

 Experience in negotiating collaborations, briefing influencers, coordinating approvals, managing publishing schedules, and ensuring timely campaign delivery
 



**Narrative Monitoring \& Social Listening** 




 Strong understanding of online conversations, sentiment tracking, trend identification, and rapid\-response coordination across digital platforms.

Performance Marketing Executive
 



*Jewellery \| Full\-Time \| Janakpuri* 




  





 Company: Cao Jewellery
 



 Location: Janakpuri, New Delhi (Work from Office)
 



 Working Days: Monday – Saturday (6 Days)
 



 Experience: 3\+ Years — Preferably in Jewellery / Fashion / D2C / E\-Commerce
 



 Important — Preferred Industry Background
 



  





 Strong preference for candidates with hands\-on performance marketing experience in Jewellery, Fashion, D2C, or E\-Commerce. Candidates from outside this domain may be considered only with a clearly demonstrated track record of scaling D2C\-style funnels. 
 



  





 ABOUT THE ROLE
 



  





 Cao Jewellery is a handcrafted statement jewellery brand on a mission to change the way the world experiences jewellery. We believe that beautifully crafted, meaningful pieces shouldn't be reserved for the few, they should be within reach of every person who desires them. We're looking for a highly driven, data\-oriented Performance Marketing Executive to scale our digital growth across paid channels. You'll own customer acquisition, funnel optimization, and ROAS scaling across Meta, Google, and other platforms — turning ad spend into a predictable revenue engine. 
 



  





 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





 Plan, execute, and optimize paid campaigns across Meta Ads (Facebook \& Instagram), Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube), other platforms.
 



 Own the end\-to\-end performance marketing funnel — Awareness → Consideration → Conversion— and the metrics at every stage.
 



 Drive customer acquisition and revenue growth while holding the line on target ROAS and CPA.
 



 Analyze campaign performance daily, spot trends early, and scale winning audiences, creatives, and placements.
 



 Run structured A/B tests on creatives, audiences, landing pages, and ad copy — and turn learnings into the next round.
 



 Partner closely with creative, content, and brand teams to brief and ship high\-converting ad assets, including UGC and influencer\-led creatives.
 



 Track and report key metrics — CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS, LTV — in clean, decision\-ready dashboards.
 



 Optimize landing pages and conversion funnels in collaboration with the website/Shopify team for better CVR.
 



 Plan and allocate monthly budgets across platforms, channels, and campaigns to maximize blended ROAS.
 



 Stay ahead of platform updates, algorithm shifts, and competitor strategies — and translate them into our roadmap.
 



  





 REQUIRED SKILLS \& QUALIFICATIONS
 



  




1. 3\+ years of hands\-on performance marketing experience, preferably in jewellery, fashion, or D2C e\-commerce.
2. Proven track record of scaling paid campaigns with strong, sustained ROI / ROAS.
3. Hands\-on expertise in Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube), and other platforms.
4. Sharp analytical skills and a data\-driven mindset — you make decisions with numbers, not gut alone.
5. Working knowledge of tracking tools — Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, and UTM tracking.
6. Solid understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO) and funnel diagnostics.
7. Experience managing high ad spends with consistent, predictable performance.
8. Excellent communication skills and the ability to manage stakeholders across creative, brand, and leadership teams.



  





 YOU'LL STAND OUT IF YOU HAVE
 



  




1. Experience running performance marketing for a Shopify or similar D2C e\-commerce stack.
2. A strong point of view on influencer / UGC\-driven performance creatives — what works, what doesn't, and why.
3. Familiarity with GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, and Microsoft Clarity.
4. A bias for action, ownership mentality, and hunger to grow a brand from the inside.



  





 WHY JOIN US
 



  




1. Chance to work with a growing premium fashion brand.
2. Opportunity to scale Ad spends and Brand Visibility.

 ?**

 **inbound marketing motion**

 **traffic → lead → MQL → SQL → opportunity → pipeline** 
 .

* Build repeatable demand\-generation programs that can scale across markets and segments.

 .

* Partner with relevant technical and operational teams to build and continuously improve automation.
* Build processes that enable campaigns and GTM motions to scale without creating operational complexity.
* Identify repetitive GTM processes and turn them into
 **automated, measurable workflows** 
 .

* Own the marketing technology ecosystem, including CRM/MAP, lead scoring, routing, integrations and data flows.
* Own lead lifecycle definitions, handoffs and operational processes between Marketing and Sales.
* Build and maintain SOPs, governance and reporting frameworks.
* Ensure marketing data is accurate, consistent and trusted by Sales and leadership.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through technology and automation.

 .

 **$350K\+ paid media budget** 
 across Search and Social.

 **SQL, pipeline, CAC and revenue efficiency** 
 , rather than clicks or MQLs alone.

* Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, SDR, CX and Regional Marketing teams to execute launches.

* Ensure new product, feature and market launches have the right
 **campaign, audience, channel, automation and measurement infrastructure** 
 .
* Create a consistent operating rhythm across Marketing and Sales.

* Build a reporting framework that connects marketing activity to
 **funnel movement and pipeline** 
 .
* Own metrics across acquisition, conversion, CAC, pipeline contribution and channel efficiency.
* Establish clear attribution and measurement methodologies.
* Use data to make decisions on channel investment, campaign prioritisation and resource allocation.
* Ensure Marketing performance is understood in the language of
 **business and revenue** 
 , not vanity metrics.

 ?** 




  





 This isn't a "run the channels" role.
 



 You will be responsible for building the

 If you have already taken a functioning B2B growth engine from
 **10→100** 
 and know how to make it more efficient, measurable and scalable, this role is for you.

* Brand guidelines

* Mandatory talking points
* Do's \& Don'ts
* Platform requirements
* Disclosure requirements
* Track revisions and ensure creators incorporate feedback correctly.

* Content submissions

* Coordinate client feedback and ensure the same is accurately communicated to creators.

 We've spent 8 years turning energy waste into profit for industry leaders like ABB, LG, PepsiCo, Haldiram's, Bosch, Lenskart, Times of India, Adobe, Leela Palace, and Emaar, delivering ₹256 crore in cost savings and 2\.5 lakh tonnes of CO₂ reduction.  Real runway with disciplined growth over 8 years.

 Your work moves revenue

 Turn complex energy work into clear stories and repeatable growth. You'll own a few projects end to end and work closely with the founders, marketing lead, sales team, designers, and video editors.

 We use AI extensively and responsibly to speed up our workflows, but the thinking is still done by the humans at Energeia. Knowing when the output is bland or wrong, and fixing it, is the skill we're hiring for. This is the heart of the role, not an add\-on. We're building more of our marketing on agentic AI workflows, and you'll work alongside the marketing lead to run and sharpen them, a rare chance to learn how a modern marketing function is actually built.

* Write \& ship content like case studies, blogs, LinkedIn copy, etc.

* Scope and manage project hand\-offs to our external design and video partners
* Run occasional email campaigns end\-to\-end

**Must\-haves** 



* Sharp critical thinking and reasoning ability.
* Previous B2B marketing or sales experience

* Excellent English; conversational Hindi.
* Refined and detail\-oriented design eye.

 →
 
 Short take\-home

 Final round.

title: Business Marketing Manager
description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.
   

  

 Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.
   

  

 We are looking for a Business Marketing Manager, Radiation Oncology Solutions (ROS), to join our Asia Pacific Japan (APJ) Business Management team. Reporting to the Head of Business Management, ROS APJ, this role will focus on working with product marketing teams on business planning, performance management \& portfolio strategy, and develop competitive strategies and tactics that accelerate profitable growth. The successful candidate will combine strong analytical capability with commercial judgement and cross\-functional leadership to influence priorities across regional, zone and global teams.
   

  

 Business Planning and Performance Management
   

  

* Support the Director of Product Marketing on the APJ annual and long\-range business planning process for assigned ROS portfolios, translating strategic priorities into market assumptions, growth targets, resource requirements and executable initiatives.
* Build robust business cases, market projections, forecasts and scenario analyses using market size, installed\-base, pricing, funnel, revenue, margin and adoption data.
* Define clear objectives, KPIs and governance routines; track performance against plan, identify gaps and recommend corrective actions.
* Partner with Finance, Sales and marketing teams in APJ zones, as well as the Head of Business Management to align assumptions and maintain a fact\-based view of opportunities, risks and priorities.
* Prepare concise executive recommendations and decision materials for APJ and global leadership.
* Analyze sales, market, customer, and operational data to identify trends, opportunities, and risks.
* Support the Director of Product Marketing on the pricing quality initiatives to improve the quality of product and service pricing.


 Portfolio Strategy and optimization
   

  

* Support the Director of Product Marketing and the product marketing managers to develop and maintain a coherent APJ portfolio strategy across the product lifecycle, from pre\-launch and launch through adoption, upgrades, upsell and transition planning.
* Assess portfolio attractiveness, strategic fit, differentiation, profitability and market readiness to recommend investment, sequencing and resource priorities.
* Support the Director of Product Marketing and the team in driving the regional installed base (IB) adoption for upgrades, upsell, replacement, and end\-of\-support transitions.
* Translate the IB\-related product roadmap changes e.g. high margins upsells and upgrades into regional customer, commercial and lifecycle actions, in collaboration with zone teams, product marketing, commercial excellence and customer service teams.
* Establish disciplined IB sales opportunity management and forecasting, identify and implement improvements to IB sales processes, tools and ways of working to increase visibility, forecast accuracy, conversion and execution efficiency.
* Work closely with Commercialization Excellence team to design, maintain, and enhance dashboards and reports using business intelligence tools.


- 

 Market Landscape and Strategic Insights
   

  

* Develop and maintain an integrated APJ market landscape covering market size and growth, customer segments, installed base, clinical and technology trends, reimbursement, regulation, channels and access barriers.
* Combine primary and secondary research, voice\-of\-customer insights and internal data to identify unmet needs, whitespace opportunities and emerging risks.
* Create repeatable analytical frameworks, dashboards and market models that improve planning quality and support evidence\-based decision\-making.
* Shape segmentation framework, targeting, positioning, value propositions, pricing and channel approaches for diverse APJ markets, together with the product marketing teams.
* Translate complex market information into clear implications and recommended actions for product, commercial and leadership teams.


 Competitive Strategy and Tactical Execution
   

  

* Establish a structured competitive intelligence process to monitor competitor portfolios, value propositions, pricing, partnerships, evidence, channels and go\-to\-market moves.
* Develop competitive strategies, market\-specific plays, battlecards, objection\-handling guidance and account\-level tactics that enable differentiated customer engagement.
* Anticipate competitor responses and define countermeasures, including positioning, pricing, evidence generation, stakeholder engagement and channel actions.
* Equip regional and zone teams with actionable insights and capability\-building programmes; capture field feedback and continuously refine tactics based on outcomes.


 Cross\-Functional Leadership and Execution
   

  

* Lead cross\-functional programmes spanning Product Management, Sales, Finance, Clinical, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Service, Applications and Marketing Communications.
* Convert strategy into prioritised workplans with clear owners, milestones, decision points and measurable outcomes.
* Influence without direct authority, challenge assumptions constructively and build alignment across countries, functions and seniority levels.
* Drive disciplined review cycles and adapt strategies and tactics as market conditions, customer needs and portfolio priorities evolve.


**Education And Experience**
* Bachelor degree or above. Oncology related or Business degree with extensive oncology or business management field acceptable.
* A total of 10\+ years of relevant experience in business management, strategic planning, portfolio or product management, or related roles within a large healthcare or medical technology solutions company, preferably including regional or global responsibility. A strong background in oncology is preferred; experience in a Radiation Oncology department and expertise in treatment planning are additional advantages.
* Proven presentation \& communication skills and ability to influence colleagues.
* Possesses high energy, self\-directed, team player and detail oriented with a sense of excitement both internally and externally for our products and our company.
* Strong interpersonal skills and communication skills.
* Demonstrated capability in business planning, financial and market modelling, scenario development, forecasting, KPI design and performance management.
* Proven experience developing portfolio, segmentation, positioning, pricing, lifecycle and go\-to\-market strategies in complex, multi\-country markets.
* Strong market research and competitive intelligence skills, with the ability to synthesize diverse data into clear strategic implications and practical tactics.
* Willing to travel \>30% of the time. Flexibility to travel and work on the weekends as this position requires to support country in the entire APJ region.
* Flexible work hours due to global communication needs of the position which will involve some early morning and evening calls.
* Must possess excellent written, verbal and visual communication skills with excellent command of written and spoken English.
* Working Location: Any of the countries in Asia Pacific – Singapore/Japan/ Korea/ Malaysia/Thailand


**Preferred Skillsets**
* Strong leadership experience with the ability to manage, develop and lead a diverse group across various locations.
* Experience leading strategic planning, portfolio management, market landscaping and competitive strategy in healthcare, medical technology or another complex B2B environment.

You will create a culture of accountability, collaboration, learning and continuous improvement that turns insight into measurable revenue, channel and share outcomes.

title: Head - Brand Communication & Digital Marketing
description:
**Role Objective** 




 To lead Merino’s brand presence and communication agenda with equal ownership of Brand Communication and Digital Marketing. The role will be responsible for strengthening brand positioning and visibility, developing integrated communication platforms, driving media planning and effectiveness, and building a strong, consistent and always\-on digital presence across social media, website and other digital touchpoints. The role will translate business and consumer priorities into compelling brand stories, campaigns and digital experiences that enhance awareness, engagement and brand preference.
 



  





**Job Responsibilities** 




  





 1\.
 **Brand Strategy, Positioning \& Brand Presence** 



* Define and strengthen Merino’s brand positioning, personality, value proposition and communication territories in alignment with business strategy.
* Develop the annual brand communication roadmap and campaign calendar across key consumer, influencer, trade and corporate audiences.
* Drive consistent brand presence and expression across ATL, BTL, retail, trade, digital, social and other consumer touchpoints.
* Identify opportunities to increase Merino’s visibility, salience and share of voice within the laminates and broader building\-materials category.
* Establish and maintain brand guidelines and ensure consistent application across internal teams, agencies and external partners.



  





**2\. Integrated Brand Communication \& Campaigns** 



* Lead development and execution of integrated brand campaigns from brief to market, including campaign strategy, creative development, production and rollout.
* Partner with creative agencies to develop distinctive communication platforms, campaign ideas, content and brand assets.
* Ensure alignment of communication across TV/CTV, OTT, print, outdoor, retail, influencer, digital and social channels wherever relevant.
* Evaluate campaign effectiveness and use insights to improve communication impact, reach and brand consideration.
* Drive communication for new product/collection launches, brand initiatives and key business priorities.



  





**3\. Media Planning \& Investment** 



* Own media planning strategy, annual media calendar and channel mix across traditional and digital media.
* Lead media agency relationships, media planning, buying, negotiations and performance reviews.
* Define media objectives, target audiences, channel roles and investment allocation for key campaigns.
* Track reach, frequency, cost efficiency, share of voice and campaign performance; recommend evidence\-based optimization.
* Ensure effective utilization, transparency and governance of media spends.



  





**4\. Digital Brand \& Social Media Leadership** 




  




* Own Merino’s digital brand presence across website, social media platforms, content properties and other relevant digital touchpoints.
* Define the digital content strategy, editorial calendar, platform\-wise content approach and tone of voice for Merino.
* Lead the end\-to\-end management of social handles, including content planning, publishing, engagement, community management and reputation monitoring.
* Build an always\-on digital presence through relevant, engaging and platform\-native content including video, reels, stories, campaigns and brand\-led conversations.
* Drive digital\-first storytelling and identify emerging platforms, formats, creators and trends relevant to the brand.
* Monitor digital performance through reach, engagement, traffic, audience growth, sentiment and other relevant metrics, and translate insights into action.
* Ensure website and digital touchpoints remain current, brand\-consistent, user\-friendly and aligned with communication priorities.



  





**5\. Content, Influencer \& Online Reputation** 



* Develop a structured content ecosystem covering brand stories, product/collection narratives, design inspiration, consumer engagement and corporate brand content.
* Work with influencer, creator and content partners to build relevant brand advocacy and digital visibility.
* Monitor online conversations, comments, reviews and sentiment; coordinate timely responses and escalation where required.
* Identify opportunities for earned digital visibility, partnerships and culturally relevant brand conversations.



  





**6\. Agency, Team \& Budget Leadership** 



* Lead and manage creative, media, digital, social, PR, production and content agency partners as relevant to the brand agenda.
* Set clear briefs, deliverables, timelines and performance expectations for agency partners.
* Lead the brand and digital communication team, building capability, accountability and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Own the brand communication and digital marketing budget, ensuring disciplined allocation and return on marketing investment.
* Institutionalize processes, dashboards, content calendars, campaign measurement and governance standards.

title: Content Lead & Growth
description:
**About StartupGyaan** 



* StartupGyaan is one of India's established business and startup media brands, with:495K\+ YouTube subscribers277K\+ Instagram followers
* 165K\+ FounderGyaan YouTube subscribers
* 91K\+ FounderGyaan Instagram followers



  





  





 We've been building content around startups, businesses, founders and entrepreneurship for nearly a decade. We also work closely with prominent founders and business families across India, creating their content and personal brands.
 



  





 But we're not satisfied with where we've reached.
 



  





 We're looking for someone who can help us build the next version of StartupGyaan.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 We're looking for a Content \& Growth Lead who can take ownership of StartupGyaan's content strategy and help us build a high\-growth, personality\-driven business media brand.
 



  





 Your first and most important mandate will be: Make StartupGyaan's Instagram Reels impossible to ignore.
 



  





 You'll be responsible for understanding what makes people stop scrolling, developing repeatable content formats and IPs, building a strong brand persona, and eventually expanding that strategy into podcasts, long\-form YouTube and other formats.
 



  





 This isn't a role where you'll simply receive a content calendar and execute it.
 



  





 You'll be expected to think, experiment, analyse, fail, learn and build.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




 1\. Instagram Reels — Primary Responsibility
 



 Develop the overall short\-form content strategy for StartupGyaan
 


* Identify topics, trends, narratives and formats with high potential
* Develop strong hooks and storytelling structures
* Create and improve scripts
* Develop repeatable Reel formats/IPs
* Analyse performance and continuously optimise content
* Study retention, shares, saves, comments and follower conversion
* Identify why certain content works and why other content doesn't
* Build a system capable of consistently producing high\-performing organic content



  





 2\. Build the StartupGyaan Brand \& Personality:
 



 We don't want StartupGyaan to remain just another "startup/business facts" page. You will help develop:
 


* Brand personality
* Tone of voice
* Content philosophy
* Storytelling style
* Point of view
* Recurring themes
* Founder/personal\-brand integration
* Distinctive content formats



  





 The goal is to make people recognise:"This is StartupGyaan"even before they see the logo.
 



  





 3\. Build Arnab's Personal Brand:
 



 A major part of this role will be developing the founder's presence within StartupGyaan. You'll work closely with Arnab to develop:
 


* His on\-camera personality
* Opinions and points of view
* Storytelling style
* Recurring personal\-brand formats
* Founder\-led content
* Business commentary
* Behind\-the\-scenes content
* Thought leadership



  





 The objective is to create a genuine connection between Arnab and the audience, rather than having StartupGyaan feel like a faceless media page.
 



  





 4\. Content IP Development: You will be expected to build repeatable content properties, not just individual viral Reels. For example:
 


* Business breakdown formats
* Founder stories
* Business controversies
* Contrarian opinions
* Business economics
* "How this company actually makes money"
* Indian business stories
* Founder insights



  





 You'll constantly ask:"Can we turn this into a format that we can make 100 times?"
 



  





 5\. Analytics \& Growth: You will own the content performance dashboard. Track:
 


* Views
* Reach
* Watch time
* Retention
* Shares
* Saves
* Comments
* Follower growth
* Follows per 1,000 views
* Format performance
* Topic performance
* Hook performance



  





 And most importantly:Turn data into decisions. We don't want monthly reports saying
 *"This Reel got 300K views."* 
 We want:"This format worked because X. Let's make five variations next week."
 



  





 6\. Podcast \& Long\-Form — Eventually Once the short\-form engine starts working, you'll gradually take ownership of:
 


* FounderGyaan Podcast positioning
* Episode concepts
* Guest selection
* Interview formats
* Storytelling
* Clips
* Distribution strategy
* YouTubeLong\-form concepts
* Titles
* Thumbnails
* Packaging
* Storytelling
* Retention
* Content series



  





 The objective is to eventually build a content ecosystem, rather than treating Instagram, YouTube and podcasts as separate businesses.
 



  





 7\. Research \& Trend Intelligence: You should be someone who naturally spends time consuming content. You'll be expected to constantly study:
 


* Indian creators
* Global creators
* Business/finance creators
* Emerging Instagram formats
* YouTube formats
* Gen\-Z content behaviour
* Trending narratives
* New content IPs
* Competitor strategies



  





 You should know what is working today and have an opinion on what might work six months from now.
 



  





 8\. Work With the Existing Team.
 


* You'll work closely with:
* Reel editors
* Videographers
* Content strategists
* Operations
* Founder



 You won't necessarily edit every video yourself. Instead, you'll own the creative direction and quality bar.
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 Must\-have
 


* 3–6 years of experience in content, creator economy, digital media or social media
* Strong understanding of Instagram Reels and short\-form content
* Proven experience growing social media pages organically
* Excellent understanding of hooks, storytelling and retention
* Strong scripting ability
* Strong content ideation ability
* Understanding of social\-media analytics
* Ability to identify patterns from content performance
* Excellent communication skills
* Strong business/current\-affairs awareness
* Ability to work independently and take ownership



  





**Strongly Preferred** 




 We'd love to see candidates who have:
 


* Personally grown a creator/media page
* Worked with a prominent creator
* Generated 10M\+ organic views
* Built a recurring content format/IP
* Experience in business, finance, startup or entrepreneurship content
* On\-camera experience
* Experience with YouTube Shorts
* Experience building personal brands



  





 Proven results matter more to us than degrees or fancy job titles.
 



  





**What We Don't Want** 




 This is important enough that I'd put it in the job post.
 



  





 We're not looking for someone whose primary experience is:
 



 ❌ Posting content according to a calendar
 



 ❌ Managing brand pages mechanically
 



 ❌ Copy\-pasting trends
 



 ❌ Writing generic motivational scripts
 



 ❌ Following viral audio trends without understanding why they work
 



 ❌ Creating monthly social\-media reports without taking action
 



 ❌ Waiting for instructions
 



  





 We're looking for someone who can say:"I think we should completely change this."—and then prove why.
 



  





**Requirements:** 



* Laptop
* Ability to work full\-time from office
* Self\-driven, curious, and detail\-oriented
* Minimum 1 year experience in content writing / scripting / digital content

title: Manager Business Growth
description:
**About Urban Company** 




  





 Urban Company is a technology platform offering customers a variety of services at home. Customers use our platform to book services such as beauty treatments, haircuts, massage therapy, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting etc., all delivered in the comfort of their home and at a time of their choosing. We promise our customers a high\-quality, standardized and reliable service experience. To fulfill this promise, we work closely with our hand\-picked service partners, enabling them with technology, training, products, tools, financing, insurance, and brand, helping them succeed and deliver on this promise.
 



  





 Urban Company started out as UrbanClap in Nov 2014, when its founders, Abhiraj, Raghav and Varun realized that the home services industry was predominantly unorganized, fragmented and offline. Customers found it difficult to avail quality services in a convenient manner, and service professionals were struggling to make ends meet, having to rely upon several middlemen, contractors, and local aggregators. The founders felt that the industry was ripe for disruption, and launched Urban Company, with three key principles in mind \-
 


* Customer love: Build a platform that offers truly delightful and differentiated services
* Partner empowerment: Build a deep, full\-stack partnership with service partners, helping improve their earnings and overall livelihood
* Technology first: Bring innovation and technology to an age\-old industry.



  





**About the Role:** 




 The Manager Business Growth (Marketing) at UC own and deliver the growth and business outcomes of a business unit at UC (Super category). They engage with multi\-functional teams and agency partners to develop and execute strategies for the business’s success. They lead a mix of Marketing projects enabling them to show the breadth and depth of their leadership. They need to derive consumer insights, which would unlock the next level of business growth. We are looking for colleagues who aren't afraid to take smart risks and innovate.
 



  





**What you’ll do:** 




  





**I. Solving Design Problems:** 




  





**A. Product/Offering** 
 \- Building the right service offering closely with the business team. Eg: 1\) Should we launch a new female waxing variant in South India? 2\) Should we launch video consulting for Appliance Repairs? 3\) Do we need an extended warranty with repairs? 4\) Which is the next innovation we can pilot in facials etc.
 



  





**B. Price** 
 \- Working with the business team to define the optimum pricing constructs to maximize Revenues. Eg: What is the marginal cost of servicing the second AC and what should be the right price we should charge the consumer, what is our price against our competitors etc.
 



  





**C. Packaging** 
 \- Does our App (storefront) have the right information/demonstration to solve all the underlying consumer queries? Is our flow watertight? Are the images apt? Eg: In a Salon Luxury variant, how do we communicate luxury through the right images and nomenclature?
 



  





**II. Solving Deployment Problems** 




  





**A. Proposition** 
 : “Why” would someone consider you over other alternatives? What is the payoff for the consumer, what is the insight around it and how do we structure our nudge in a way that lands it. Eg: UC’s new low\-pain roll on waxing, Get 2X faster cooling with UC’s AC servicing
 



  





**B. Place** 
 : Ensuring the demand\-supply match across key markets. Do we have the right depth of supply where there is demand and are we building enough reach within our TG where we have excess supply
 



  





**C. Promotions** 
 : Deploying the marketing budget towards a mix of the right channels and insights based on the proposition. The channels may include a mix of online and offline channels, including strategic partnerships
 



  





**What we’ll need:** 




 ● 2\+ years of relevant experience with high scale start ups or FMCGs
 



 ● Bachelor's/MBA degree or equivalent
 



 ● Ability to move fast and break things
 



 ● Strong analytical skills
 



  





 At Urban Company, we are committed to providing equal and fair opportunities in employment and creating an inclusive work environment. We endeavor to maintain a work environment free from harassment based on age, colour, physical ability, marital status, parental status, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, or gender identity.

**Entrepreneur in Residence \- Healthcare Data for AI** 




  





**The Opportunity** 




 We are building a new healthcare data business that helps leading AI labs and technology companies develop better medical AI.
 



 India has enormous clinical diversity, healthcare expertise, and medical data infrastructure. Our goal is to build the trusted bridge between global AI companies and Indian hospitals, clinics, laboratories, physician networks, and healthcare professionals.
 



 We are looking for an Entrepreneur in Residence to build this business with us from the ground up.

* Identify the most valuable healthcare data requirements across AI labs, healthtech companies, and research organisations

* Develop partnerships with hospitals, clinics, laboratories, medical colleges, and physician networks

* 3 to 7 years of experience in startups, healthcare, AI, consulting, business development, or venture building

* Strong research, communication, negotiation, and project\-management skills

**Experience in healthcare data, AI training data, clinical research, hospital partnerships, data operations, or selling to global technology companies is valuable, but not mandatory.** 




  





**Why This Role** 




 This is not a conventional strategy or partnerships position. You will work directly with the founders, test the market, close initial customers and partners, deliver projects, and build the operating model for a potentially large global business.
 



 The right person can grow into the Business Head for this vertical.
 



**Compensation:**

title: Marketing & Content Intern
description:
Rev AI Pvt. Ltd. is building RevampKey, an AI\-powered software development platform.
 



  





 We are looking for someone who wants to learn how serious technology marketing is built.
 



  





 This is not a copy\-paste social media role.
 



  





 Our audience includes founders, senior technology executives, engineering leaders, and other decision\-makers. To communicate with them, we need more than a regular posting schedule.
 



  





 Every piece of content should begin with a question:
 



  





 What is worth saying?
 



 Who needs to hear it?
 



 What problem does it help them understand?
 



 What evidence or experience makes it credible?
 



 Why would someone remember it or share it?
 



  





 You will be expected to research before writing, find original angles, understand the audience, and turn complex product and technology ideas into clear, useful communication.
 



  





 You will work on:
 



  





 • Researching technology, software development, AI, startup, and executive audiences
 



 • Developing original content ideas for LinkedIn and other relevant channels
 



 • Writing thoughtful founder\-led posts, product stories, and campaign content
 



 • Managing social media profiles and marketing channels
 



 • Creating presentations, marketing decks, campaign briefs, and research summaries
 



 • Editing basic videos for product communication and social media
 



 • Studying content performance and learning why certain ideas work
 



 • Working directly with the founder and product team
 



  





 We are not looking for someone who only wants to fill a content calendar.
 



  





 We are looking for someone who is curious, thoughtful, comfortable with research, open to feedback, and willing to put real effort into improving their work.
 



  





 MBA or postgraduate students specializing in Marketing are preferred. Freshers and BTech graduates with a genuine interest in marketing, content, technology, or communication are also welcome.
 



  





 You should have:
 



  





 • Strong written and spoken English
 



 • Basic knowledge of presentations, social media, and video editing
 



 • An interest in technology and business
 



 • The ability to think independently and ask better questions
 



 • A willingness to learn, take ownership, and work in an early\-stage startup environment
 



  





 By the end of this internship, you should have more than a certificate or another line on your CV. You should have stronger skills in research, writing, communication, content strategy, presentation, and execution.
 



  





 To apply, send your CV along with:
 



  





 1\. One example of work you have created, if available
 



 2\. One original content idea for founders or technology executives
 



 3\. A short note explaining why you want to learn technology marketing
 



  





 Good marketing does not begin with, “What should we post today?”
 



  





 It begins with, “What is worth saying, who needs to hear it, and why should they care?”
 



  





 If that is the kind of work you want to learn, we would be happy to hear from you.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
**Eicore Technologies · Gurgaon · Full\-time, In\-Office, Experience 4\-6years** 




  





**Eicore is rebuilding the insurance core as the operating system for autonomous insurers.** 




 Founded by people who came from the insurance industry, and trusted by leading insurers across India, Asia\-Pacific and the Middle East, we combine deep domain experience with a platform that has quietly run critical operations for over two decades, processing millions of policies and managing significant premium volumes every year. Names you know, including SBI, run on what we build.
 



 This is a founding\-team marketing role, with the canvas of a startup and none of the risk. The customers, the revenue and the credibility are already in place. You get to help build the marketing function on top of it, at a company that is about to have its most ambitious chapter.
 



 We are looking for a brilliant generalist to help build it.
 



  





**The role** 




 This is a broad, hands\-on role for someone who has done a bit of everything in marketing and wants to do more of it, with real ownership. You will work closely with our fractional CMO and directly with the founders, and see the impact of your work quickly, because there are no layers between you and the people making decisions.
 



 It is a thinker, dreamer and doer role. You will help shape how a modern insurance company shows up in the world and then roll up your sleeves and make it happen yourself. As we grow, you will help build the team, the partners and the tools around you.
 



 You should be
 **AI\-native** 
 : someone who reaches for AI tools by instinct, uses them to work faster and better, and is excited to help build a marketing function that is AI\-first from the ground up.
 



  





**What you will work across** 



* **Digital marketing** 
 , campaigns, LinkedIn, email, web, and the numbers behind them
* **Content marketing** 
 , from thought leadership to product stories to social, written like a human, not a brand
* **Brand** 
 , keeping everything, we put out sharp, consistent and premium
* **PR and communications** 
 , press, announcements, and building our voice in the market
* **Field and event marketing** 
 , roundtables, conferences and the moments that put us in front of insurers
* **Marketing operations and AI** 
 , the tools, workflows and AI infrastructure that let a lean team punch far above its weight



 You will not be expected to be a world expert in all of these on day one. You will be expected to have
 *done* 
 most of them, to learn fast, and to be the kind of person who figures out the rest.
 



  





**You will thrive here if you** 



* **Write well and know it.** 
 Not "communicate clearly", well. Most of what you make here is words, and the difference between adequate and good is the difference between an analyst returning your call and not.
* **Are a genuine generalist who gets a kick out of shipping.** 
 Around 4 to 6 years across B2B marketing, in tech, SaaS, fintech or insurance, with enough range that you have run an event, written a launch, argued with a designer, and fixed a campaign that was not working. We care more about the shape of that than the number.
* **Think like an owner** 
 and move without waiting to be told.
* **Find insurance more interesting than boring.** 
 You will get curious about claims, underwriting, and why an insurer in Kuala Lumpur has different problems than one in Mumbai.
* **Have your own way of working with AI and can defend it.** 
 We will ask you to walk us through it. "I use ChatGPT a lot" is not an answer.



  





**Why this is worth your time** 



* This is a world class product, and you will be marketing it to the world. Taking cutting edge platform concepts and making them land with the people who buy them.
* You will sit in the thick of B2B enterprise SaaS, at the point where AI agents and humans start working side by side. Not a trend deck, an actual product doing it.
* You will help build a marketing function from early days, at a company that already has the customers and credibility most startups spend a decade chasing.
* You will work directly with the founders, and learn the business, not just the marketing.
* You will own real scope, not a corner of someone else's plan.
* You will do the most interesting work of your career so far, if you are the right person.



  





 If that sounds like you, we would like to meet you.

title: (Associate) Director, Expansion & Partnerships, AI Access Initiative (EAII)
description:
This position is with EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India.
   

  

**About EAII**
 EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence\-based public health programs, including safe drinking water initiatives and school and Anganwadi\-based National Deworming Day and iron and folic acid supplementation. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long\-term wellbeing of children and families.
   

  

 For more information, read about our work here: About Evidence Action and EAII
   

  

**About The AI Access Initiative (2AI)**
 We're at an inflection point in artificial intelligence \- presenting both tremendous potential opportunity and risk for people in developing countries. AI capabilities are improving on a timescale measured in months, while development systems often move on timescales measured in decades. Much of the technology needed for positive impact exists today, but few organizations exist to bridge research, deployment, and scaled implementation: we must act now to ensure AI's benefits reach people in poverty in LMICs.
   

  

 Incubated at Evidence Action, we're scaling The AI Access Initiative, an organization focused on scaling AI\-enabled 'big bets' to benefit tens or hundreds of millions of people in poverty in low\- and middle\-income countries (LMICs). We operate at the intersection of global development actors, top AI labs, and leading researchers to drive meaningful access to AI's benefits for the 3\.5 billion people living in poverty globally. We create "public good," open\-sourced playbooks, toolkits, and insights that define how to design and launch tractable and impactful AI\-enabled programs. Given the scale of opportunity, we expect our portfolio to expand substantially, but to start, we're scaling two programs focused on AI in Agriculture and AI in Health.
   

  

 We are led by former Evidence Action CEO Kanika Bahl, a founding member of Anthropic's Long\-Term Benefit Trust, and advised by Nobel Laureate Michael Kremer; Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic; and Kent Walker, President, Global Affairs for Alphabet and Google. This work builds on Evidence Action's track record reaching 530M\+ people with cost\-effective, evidence\-based programs across 9 countries in Africa and Asia, with a focus on last\-mile delivery.
   

  

**The Role**
 2AI is building fast. We have a founding team, two live program portfolios, and a pipeline of opportunities that will drive significant expansion. The programs we are running have credible pathways to 100s of millions of people. While incubated at Evidence Action, we plan to spin out in Q4 '26\.
   

  

 Our Agriculture portfolio is scaling AI\-enabled weather forecasting services to reach tens of millions of smallholder farmers, in close partnership with state and national governments in India. The next phase is to expand this work: deciding which countries we move into next and building what it takes to operate there. We are seeking a rigorous, high\-ownership Associate Director or Director, Expansion \& Partnerships to own that expansion end to end, from market selection and government and telco partnerships through to standing up offices and teams in new markets.
   

  

 This role is based in India and sits on 2AI's global team, reporting into the VP, Agriculture. It includes people leadership, managing at least one senior manager across the program. You will work closely with our India country team and other in\-country team members to scope and expand programming.
   

  

**You Will:**
* Identify new markets for forecast delivery: In conjunction with the VP, Agriculture, develop the criteria for market selection and prioritize countries to expand into
* Stand up new markets: Once a new market is confirmed, support the set\-up of offices and the hiring of high\-quality staff with the requisite skills to implement large\-scale forecast delivery
* Oversee development of forecasts for new regions: Collaborate with academics to ensure forecasts are developed, tested, and ready to disseminate in new countries. This could include hiring and managing post\-doctoral students to support in model benchmarking or dataset support
* Lead telco partnerships: Identify target telcos and lead engagement, negotiation, and relationship management to set up sustainable telco\-based dissemination systems
* Hire and manage in\-country scoping support: Where staff on the ground are needed to determine whether there is an opportunity in a new market, hire and oversee them, for example short\-term consultants
* Build and maintain government relationships: Create new and nurture existing relationships with the government bodies needed to operate and disseminate forecasts in a new market, including agriculture departments and meteorological agencies
* Partner with stakeholders: Create new and nurture existing relationships with academic institutions, delivery partners, and other agriculture organizations.
* Develop best practices and thought leadership: Across all of the above, build best practices and replicable toolkits that can be applied elsewhere by others. Share key learnings with the sector through toolkits, blogs, and other public\-good resources


**Requirements**
 The ideal candidate is an exceptional builder with the ability to drive outcomes in a fast\-moving, high\-stakes environment. Given the startup nature of this work, we seek contributors with high throughput, strong work ethic, and willingness to lean in and work extended hours.
   

  

 You will likely have:
   

  

* 7\-10\+ years' experience as a builder in international development, consulting, or an agriculture adjacent organization
* Strong communication skills in English with experience working with international teams
* A proven track record of significantly scaling organizations and/or programs to deliver impact at scale, preferably in close partnership with national governments. Direct experience taking a program or organization into a new region is a plus
* Demonstrated success building and negotiating partnerships with governments and the private sector. Experience with telcos, mobile network operators, or platform partners is a strong plus
* Training or early career experience in a high\-rigor environment (e.g., top\-tier management consulting, high\-growth NGO program leadership, strategy/econ research) and the ability to rapidly get up to speed in new technical areas including AI/ML forecasting concepts
* A track record as a strong people manager and builder: able to set clear standards, empower others, and cultivate a high\-performance culture across distributed and field\-based teams
* Experience working with Asian and/or African governments to drive large\-scale change, with a strong preference for direct experience working with ministries of agriculture or national meteorological agencies
* High EQ and the ability to influence across diverse partners, from AI/forecasting researchers to frontline delivery staff to senior government officials
* Strong fluency with AI tools, and eager to experiment, learn, and adapt to emerging technologies
* Comfort with ambiguity and fast iteration; can define and test hypotheses, adapt quickly, and maintain focus on impact
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to synthesize complex technical ideas (e.g., AI/ML weather forecasting language) into crisp narratives for different audiences
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively internationally (:40\-50%) to prospective and current markets across low\-and\-middle income countries
* Passion for the mission of ensuring that the benefits of frontier AI reach the world's poorest populations, while mitigating its downside risks


**Position Location**
 This role is based in India, with flexibility on location within the country. The role sits on 2AI's global team rather than within a single country program, and requires significant international travel (:40\-50%) to prospective and current markets. Evidence Action is an Equal Opportunity Employer with a commitment to diversity. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply.
   

  

 Applicants must be legally authorized to work in India. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time.
   

  

**Benefits**
 EAII provides a comprehensive benefits package for employees . Benefits include:
   

  

* Comprehensive health insurance with IPD and OPD provisions,
* Life and Accidental insurance,
* PF, ESIC and Gratuity as per statutory requirements,
* Generous leave,
* Mental and physical wellbeing benefits
* Learning \& Development benefits
* Avenues for engagement and recognition


 Compensation: Pay will be competitive and commensurate with the individual's credentials, experience and previous pay scale.
   

  

 This role will initially be housed at EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, with the explicit plan to transfer with the AI Access Initiative as a founding member of the team when that project is spun out as a new entity later this year. At that point, benefits and policies may change.

title: Vice President Influencer Marketing
description:
Role Overview
 



 We are looking for an experienced, strategic, and highly connected
 **Vice President Influencer Marketing** 
 to lead our influencer and creator marketing function. This person will own the influencer strategy end\-to\-end—from creator identification and partnerships to campaign execution, measurement, and long\-term relationship building.
 



 The ideal candidate combines strong strategic thinking with deep knowledge of the creator ecosystem, excellent negotiation skills, commercial acumen, and a proven ability to build high\-performing influencer programs at scale.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



**1\. Influencer Strategy \& Leadership** 



* Develop and own the overall influencer and creator marketing strategy aligned with brand and business objectives.
* Build annual and quarterly influencer marketing plans, budgets, and growth strategies.
* Identify emerging creator trends, platforms, formats, and opportunities.
* Define the right mix of macro, mid\-tier, micro, and nano influencers for different campaign objectives.
* Establish influencer marketing as a scalable and measurable growth channel.



**2\. Creator Partnerships** 



* Build and maintain strong relationships with influencers, creators, talent managers, agencies, and creator networks.
* Identify and onboard high\-impact creators aligned with the brand's values, audience, and positioning.
* Lead contract negotiations, commercial terms, exclusivity, usage rights, and long\-term partnerships.
* Develop ambassador and always\-on creator programs.



**3\. Campaign Management** 



* Lead influencer campaigns from briefing and creator selection through execution and reporting.
* Partner closely with creative, social, PR, brand, product, and performance marketing teams.
* Develop compelling creator briefs, campaign concepts, and content frameworks.
* Ensure creator content is authentic while meeting brand, legal, and compliance requirements.
* Manage campaign timelines, deliverables, approvals, and budgets.



**4\. Performance \& Analytics** 



* Establish KPIs and measurement frameworks for influencer campaigns.
* Track metrics including reach, engagement, views, EMV, conversions, CAC/ROI, revenue, and incremental impact.
* Use data and insights to optimize creator selection, content strategy, and investment allocation.
* Build regular executive\-level reporting and recommendations.



**5\. Budget \& Commercial Management** 



* Own and manage the influencer marketing budget.
* Negotiate rates and maximize return on creator investments.
* Evaluate agency, platform, and technology partnerships.
* Develop scalable processes for forecasting, budgeting, and campaign ROI.



**6\. Team Leadership** 



* Build, mentor, and lead a high\-performing influencer marketing team.
* Set goals, KPIs, processes, and operating standards.
* Foster a culture of creativity, experimentation, accountability, and performance.
* Manage external agencies and strategic partners where required.



 Key Success Metrics
 


* Influencer\-attributed revenue and/or conversions
* Campaign ROI / ROAS
* Creator engagement and content performance
* Reach and quality of audience
* Cost per engagement / acquisition
* Growth of creator community and strategic partnerships
* Brand awareness and consideration impact
* Percentage of creator partnerships becoming repeat/long\-term collaborations



 Candidate Profile
 



**Experience** 



* 8–12\+ years of experience in influencer marketing, creator marketing, social media, digital marketing, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience leading large\-scale influencer/creator campaigns.
* Experience managing significant marketing budgets and cross\-functional teams.
* Strong network across relevant creator, talent, and agency ecosystems.
* Experience building influencer programs from strategy through execution and measurement.



  





 Interested candidates can write to us at hello@whizzhr.com
 



  





 Warm Regards

title: Power & Utilities Sector Leader
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Position Summary (Enter the description) \- Power \& Utilities Sector Leader responsible for driving sector\-led growth through origination, deal shaping, and execution of large\-scale transformation programs, with a strong emphasis on strengthening sales enablement and pipeline quality.
   

  

 Acts as a senior industry advisor, translating energy transition and utilities disruption into actionable client opportunities while building a differentiated sector proposition and positioning the firm as a partner of choice for complex, high\-value engagements.
   

  

**Objective and purpose:**
* Lead the growth agenda for the Power \& Utilities sector in GDS, defining strategic priorities, target accounts, and differentiated plays to scale the practice and drive sustained revenue growth.
* Drive origination and closure of large, complex transformation opportunities, translating sector themes such as energy transition, grid modernization, and asset optimization into actionable, high\-value deals.
* Act as a trusted advisor to P\&U C\-suite leaders, shaping enterprise transformation agendas across generation, transmission, distribution, and customer operations with a clear link to business outcomes.
* Institutionalize strong sales enablement across the sector, embedding disciplined pipeline management, pursuit excellence, sector narratives, and commercial frameworks to improve win rates and consistency.
* Build and commercialize differentiated sector offerings, including repeatable frameworks, assets, and go\-to\-market propositions, while strengthening market positioning through thought leadership and industry engagement.


**Scope of the position:**
* Own the GDS Power \& Utilities sector agenda across priority accounts, aligning global client needs with GDS capabilities to identify and shape high\-value transformation opportunities across the utilities value chain.
* Lead end\-to\-end pursuit lifecycle, including opportunity qualification, solution shaping, commercial structuring, and deal closure, ensuring strong integration with onshore teams and global account leadership.
* Drive sales enablement at scale, embedding consistent pipeline discipline, qualification frameworks, reusable sector narratives, and pursuit playbooks to improve win rates and cost of sales efficiency across deals.
* Lead integrated go\-to\-market initiatives, working across Consulting, SaT, Tax, and Assurance to bring unified, market\-facing sector solutions and drive coordinated account penetration.
* Develop and industrialize sector\-specific assets and accelerators, including playbooks, benchmarks, and solution components that enable faster deal shaping, repeatable delivery, and differentiated positioning.
* Build and maintain senior client relationships, engaging C\-suite stakeholders to position the firm as a strategic partner across energy transition, regulatory change, infrastructure modernization, and customer transformation agendas.
* Build and scale GDS alliance and ecosystem capabilities for the P\&U sector, working closely with global teams to operationalize and support partnerships, enhancing solution depth and strengthening competitiveness in large deals
* Build and scale a high\-performing P\&U capability within GDS, enhancing domain depth, pursuit leadership, and delivery excellence to support sustained sector growth and competitive advantage.


**Essential Functions Of The Job (Enter The Description)**
* Sponsor and steer priority pursuits and engagements, providing senior direction on deal strategy, solution architecture, and executive messaging to maximize win probability and value realization.
* Shape differentiated client propositions, translating complex utilities challenges (e.g., grid resilience, decarbonization, regulatory compliance, asset performance) into clear, outcome\-driven transformation narratives for senior stakeholders.
* Govern quality and consistency of proposals and deliverables, ensuring alignment with client priorities, commercial expectations, and delivery feasibility across large, multi\-tower programs.
* Drive commercial rigor in deal\-making, including pricing strategy, margin management, and contract structuring for complex transformation programs.
* Enable cross\-functional solution integration, ensuring seamless alignment of capabilities across consulting, technology, risk, and core utility operations
* Influence executive\-level client decision\-making, leading high\-stakes conversations, facilitating alignment across stakeholders, and positioning transformation initiatives in the context of enterprise value creation.
* Oversee development and evolution of sector IP, ensuring that frameworks, benchmarks, and solution components remain relevant to evolving industry trends and are effectively applied in client contexts
* Ensure strong alignment between deal strategy and delivery approach, guiding teams on shaping scalable, GDS‑led delivery models that are commercially viable, feasible, and differentiated during pursuits.
* Coach and develop senior team members on pursuit leadership and client engagement, strengthening capability in solutioning, storytelling, and executive\-level communication.


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities (Enter The Description)**
* Evaluate and prioritize pursuit opportunities, applying judgment on deal size, strategic fit, client buying appetite, competitive positioning, and win probability to guide sector focus and resource allocation.
* Make strategic decisions on solution positioning and value definition, determining which transformation levers (e.g., energy transition, grid modernization, cost optimization) to emphasize based on client context and value potential.
* Direct commercial and pricing strategy for complex deals, balancing competitiveness, margin expectations, and delivery feasibility to secure priority opportunities.
* Determine optimal GDS involvement across pursuits, making decisions on when and how to position GDS capabilities within deal constructs, including the choice of delivery model, offshore leverage, and integration with onshore teams to maximize competitiveness and value realization.
* Assess and prioritize sector investments, including development of assets, offerings, and alliance capabilities, based on market demand, pipeline trends, and potential for differentiation.
* Analyze market trends and disruption themes in Power \& Utilities, including regulatory shifts, decarbonization priorities, infrastructure investment cycles, and evolving customer models, to inform sector strategy and pursuit direction.


**Education And Experience (Enter The Description)**
* 25\+ years of relevant experience in consulting (Big 4 / strategy) and/or senior industry roles within the Power \& Utilities sector, with exposure to large\-scale transformation or business\-led growth initiatives.
* Proven track record of working with global clients and stakeholders, with experience operating across geographies and leading complex, multi\-market engagements or pursuits.
* Demonstrated experience in both industry and consulting environments (preferred), bringing a balanced perspective on sector challenges, operating models, and client decision\-making dynamics.
* Strong academic background, with an MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred; undergraduate degree in engineering, business, or a related discipline is typically expected.
* Exposure to working within global delivery or distributed team models, with familiarity in leveraging offshore/onshore constructs and collaborating across matrixed organizations.


**Knowledge And Skill Requirements (Enter The Description)**
* Deep Power \& Utilities sector expertise, with strong understanding of industry drivers such as energy transition, regulatory frameworks, grid modernization, asset\-intensive operations, and evolving customer models.
* Familiarity with core Power \& Utilities technology landscape and ecosystems, including platforms such as SAP IS‑U, Oracle Utilities, AMI/MDM systems, grid management (ADMS/EMS), and data/cloud ecosystems, with an understanding of how these enable transformation across the utilities value chain.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to interpret deal economics, value drivers, and business cases, and translate these into compelling, outcome\-focused client narratives.
* Advanced problem\-solving and structured thinking capability, with the ability to synthesize complex, multi\-dimensional client challenges into clear strategic choices and actionable priorities.
* Executive\-level communication and influencing skills, with the ability to engage credibly with C\-suite stakeholders, simplify complex topics, and drive alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.
* Ability to operate in a global, matrixed environment, collaborating effectively across geographies, service lines, and alliance ecosystems while navigating organizational complexity and competing priorities.


**Good to have (Differentiators)**
* Strong perspective on energy transition and emerging business models, including renewables integration, distributed energy resources (DER), hydrogen, and evolving market structures, with the ability to connect these shifts to long\-term utility transformation agendas.
* Exposure to grid and infrastructure modernization, including smart grids, digital substations, asset performance optimization, and resilience programs, reflecting the increasing digitization of network operations.
* Experience driving AI\- and data\-led transformation in asset\-intensive environments, including applications such as predictive maintenance, digital twins, advanced analytics, and real\-time decisioning across utility operations and customer ecosystems.
* Ability to translate global disruption trends into scalable market propositions, including navigating regulatory complexity, ESG mandates, and capital investment cycles, while identifying new growth and efficiency opportunities.
* Experience in building and leveraging ecosystem\-led solutions, including working with hyperscalers, platform providers, and industrial technology partners to shape integrated, future\-ready offerings in complex, multi\-stakeholder environments.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Associate Vice President,Client Services, India
description:
**About WPP Media**
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world\-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
   

  

 WPP Media is WPP's AI\-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
   

  

 For more information, visit wppmedia.com.
   

  

**Role**
 At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP \& WPP Media’s shared core values:
   

  

* Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
* Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
* Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.


**About EssenceMediacom: A Leading WPP Media Brand**
 EssenceMediacom is a new breed of media agency. Grounded in analytics \& insights and powered by data \& technology, we believe in the power of media and creative to drive breakthroughs for the world’s best brands. We help clients understand the modern marketing paradox and discover the breakthroughs brands need to win with their consumers. We are designed for the new communications economy — built on data \& technology, built for people \& algorithms, built around diverse schools of thought, built to test \& learn at scale, and, crucially, built to evolve.
   

  

**3 Best Things About The Job**
 Media Futures Group is part of WPP Media, the world’s largest media investment company and is a part of WPP. In fact, we are responsible for one in every three ads you see globally. We are currently looking for a Director \- Partnerships to join us for one of the biggest global brands. In this role, you will drive thought leadership on the Partnerships vertical, linking cultural insights to content opportunities and solutions across cricket, entertainment, music, sub\-culture etc. along with leading a team. This will be based on a rigorous evaluation of brand audience, objective and insights \- requiring strong logical thinking. It is NOT a role only about ideation or execution. It’s about answering the WHY, along with the HOW.
   

  

**Reporting of the role**
 This role reports to Regional (APAC), head of partnerships MFG 3 best things about the job:
   

  

* Work with best in business media partners \& teams with an objective of driving strategic partnerships and alliances with strong storytelling and brand solution.
* Attain strong understanding of cross channel media strategy \& brand partnerships by working on diversified categories of Google \& internal teams – business lead, strategy team and investment team.
* Team management, liaising with regional \& local cross\-functional specialist teams to strengthen partnership measurement while managing an experienced team under you.


 In this role, your goals will be:
   

  

**In Three Months**
* Understanding of categories and brand objectives for the year
* Proactively take initiative towards client goals for the year.
* Client engagements with senior stakeholders delivering strategic roadmaps across key consumer passions points.


**In Six Months**
* Successfully develop liaisons internally and externally with partners \& client.
* Excellent trouble shooter and a backbone for the team.
* Established a structured approach for evaluating content and brand led partnerships across TV, Digital, OTT, \& Brand Activations.
* Streamlined processes for partner management.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of content strategy into broader marketing and communication initiatives.
* In depth understanding of the In\-house products/software’s, to demonstrate the same during client conversation.
* Strong client management skills with good execution skill for multiple content projects.


**In 12 Months**
* Produce a significant and impactful body of work that directly contributes to and fulfils all key success criteria for both clients and the agency, while also meeting personal and team performance indicators.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to a team of content strategists, fostering a culture of continuous learning and professional development.
* Built high credibility with the internal teams \& client.
* Develop and implement monitoring \+ measurement frameworks to assess the effectiveness of content campaigns and optimize performance.
* Drive client satisfaction to achieve great results in form of agency scores.


**Skills And Experience**
* 10\-12\+ years of experience in building content solutions, brand partnerships, or integrated marketing and team management with hands\-on experience on executing large scale content/medium partnership across TV, Digital, OTT, Cinema \& Brand Activations.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving/story\-telling skills.
* Proven ability to lead and motivate a team.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
* Proven ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment, think strategically, and execute with precision.


**Measures Of Success – Strategic Impact**
 Platform understanding: Demonstrating strong understanding of platforms, proposing the relevant partnerships for the task
   

  

 Agility: Comfortable with use of AI tools to improve efficiency, create processes and augment proposals
   

  

 Brand understanding: Demonstrating strong understanding of brand architect, consumer and categories.
   

  

**Life At WPP Media \& Benefits**
 Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media \& WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in\-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.
   

  

 WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy\-policy) for more information on how we process the information you provide.
   

  

 While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.
   

  

 Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.
